description: Checkpoint rotation has an interruption window between two renames, while resume recreates an empty ckpt directory and has no inspected fallback to ckpt_old or ckpt_new.
trigger: Conversion is interrupted after ckpt is renamed to ckpt_old but before ckpt_new is renamed to ckpt, then resume is requested.
expected_behavior: Resume locates an available complete checkpoint or recovers the interrupted rotation.
actual_behavior: prepare_env can recreate an empty ckpt directory, after which prepare loads ckpt/job.json without an inspected fallback to ckpt_old or ckpt_new.
